versions.changelog: LLMxRay 0.8.11: the Live log survives a restart, turns can go to Jaeger, Phoenix, Langfuse or Grafana.
The four turn tools each say which question they answer and name the other three.
Requires Node.js 22+; LLMxRay 0.8.9 keeps every dependency current with npm audit clean.
GPU map and MCP tools read through Ollama 0.40.6's memory under-report; French for the 0.8 pages.
Version aligned with LLMxRay 0.8.7, which adds the Runs page. The procedure and the seven tools are unchanged.
Seven tools: list_my_turns, compare_my_turns, estimate_my_prompt and read_llmxray_status join the three; step 4 now uses compare_my_turns.
Tool names: read_my_last_turn and list_local_models replace last_turn_metrics and local_models.
No license line of its own: published here under ClawHub's MIT-0 terms, by decision.
The cache-lost-on-one-turn step now reads whether the model stayed loaded before looking for the break point.
First release. The For agents procedure from the README as a skill: route through 11435, three read-only MCP tools, the fixes for each finding.
